dialogues.jp:
「さてと、さくっと購買にでも行って、俺のエ
　サを買って来るか」
dialogues.en:
"Better go hurry up and buy my lunch before I'm left with
animal food..."
dialogues.text:
"Better go hurry up and buy my lunch before I'm left with
animal food..."

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: ぴたりと足を止める。
dialogues.en: My pace came to a halt.
dialogues.text: My pace came to a halt.

dialogues.jp:
空耳だろうか？　どっかから、誰かの怒ってい
るような声が聞こえたが……。
dialogues.en:
Am I hearing things? I could've sworn I just heard an angry
voice from somewhere...
dialogues.text:
Am I hearing things? I could've sworn I just heard an angry
voice from somewhere...

dialogues.jp: 「あ、また聞こえた」
dialogues.en: "Ah, there it is again."
dialogues.text: "Ah, there it is again."

dialogues.jp: 何となく気になって、声のする方向へと進む。
dialogues.en:
Feeling a bit worried, I head towards the direction of the
voice.
dialogues.text:
Feeling a bit worried, I head towards the direction of the
voice.

dialogues.jp: 「生物準備室……か」
dialogues.en: "From the biology room...hm."
dialogues.text: "From the biology room...hm."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「もう、お姉ちゃんたら！　ほんとに、知らな
　いんだからね！」
dialogues.en: "Come on, sis! You really don't know anything!"
dialogues.text: "Come on, sis! You really don't know anything!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……って、今の声はことりか」
dialogues.en: "..Whoa, that was Kotori's voice."
dialogues.text: "..Whoa, that was Kotori's voice."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「たのも〜」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me~"
dialogues.text: "Excuse me~"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ……朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Ah... Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Ah... Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「と、何だ、暦先生か」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「……ことりを見る目と、ずいぶん温度差を感
　じるわね」
dialogues.en:
"...Kotori's reaction towards you sure is different from
what I'm getting."
dialogues.text:
"...Kotori's reaction towards you sure is different from
what I'm getting."

dialogues.jp:
くわえタバコの暦先生が、嫌な流し目をくれて
くる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei, with a cigarette in her mouth, gave me a
sidelong glance.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei, with a cigarette in her mouth, gave me a
sidelong glance.

dialogues.jp: 「悪いっすね。根が正直なもので」
dialogues.en: "That's bad, sensei, being so direct."
dialogues.text: "That's bad, sensei, being so direct."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なお悪いわ」
dialogues.en: "How's that bad?"
dialogues.text: "How's that bad?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「は〜あ。全く。朝倉といい、ことりといい、
　どうしてもっと、講師を敬えないかね」
dialogues.en:
"Haaah, honestly. Asakura as well, Kotori as well, no one
has respect for teachers anymore."
dialogues.text:
"Haaah, honestly. Asakura as well, Kotori as well, no one
has respect for teachers anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それとこれとは、話が別でしょ」
dialogues.en: "That's got nothing to do with what we were saying!"
dialogues.text: "That's got nothing to do with what we were saying!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何をカッカとしてんの？」
dialogues.en: "What's with all the heat going on?"
dialogues.text: "What's with all the heat going on?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「これですよ、これが彼女には気にくわないん
　ですよ」
dialogues.en: "It's this. She doesn't like me doing this."
dialogues.text: "It's this. She doesn't like me doing this."

dialogues.jp:
何故かですます調で、唇からだらんと垂れてい
たタバコを上下に動かした。
dialogues.en:
With a disinterested look on her face, Koyomi waved her
cigarette up and down using her mouth lightly.
dialogues.text:
With a disinterested look on her face, Koyomi waved her
cigarette up and down using her mouth lightly.

dialogues.jp: 「喫煙ですか」
dialogues.en: "About smoking?"
dialogues.text: "About smoking?"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生は海外の俳優のように両手を広げて見せ
た。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei gave me a weird foreign gesture with her arms
that I assumed meant I was correct.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei gave me a weird foreign gesture with her arms
that I assumed meant I was correct.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ことりったら、のどの事には人一倍うるさい
　のよ」
dialogues.en:
"Of course Kotori is louder than usual in her dissent when
it comes to people's throats."
dialogues.text:
"Of course Kotori is louder than usual in her dissent when
it comes to people's throats."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんなんじゃないよっ」
dialogues.en: "That's not the point."
dialogues.text: "That's not the point."

dialogues.jp:
何というか、本気で怒っているのではなくて、
たしなめているような口調だ。
dialogues.en:
Kotori didn't really sound like she was angry; more of the
chiding tone that you'd expect older sisters to give younger
ones.
dialogues.text:
Kotori didn't really sound like she was angry; more of the
chiding tone that you'd expect older sisters to give younger
ones.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だいたい、お姉ちゃんに声なんか関係ないじゃ
　ない」
dialogues.en:
"Your voice doesn't have anything to do with what I'm trying
to say."
dialogues.text:
"Your voice doesn't have anything to do with what I'm trying
to say."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「このセクシーボイスがガラガラになったら一
　体何人の風見学園男子学生が悲しむやら……」
dialogues.en:
"If this sexy voice was ever ruined, all the male students
of Kazami Academy would be inconsolable..."
dialogues.text:
"If this sexy voice was ever ruined, all the male students
of Kazami Academy would be inconsolable..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず、俺は除外されますね」
dialogues.en: "Excepting me, of course."
dialogues.text: "Excepting me, of course."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私も」
dialogues.en: "Neither would I."
dialogues.text: "Neither would I."

dialogues.jp:
息のあった連携に、ことりがびしっと親指を立
てた。
dialogues.en: Kotori added her own assertion to mine.
dialogues.text: Kotori added her own assertion to mine.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい。分かりましたよ」
dialogues.en: "Alright, alright, I got it."
dialogues.text: "Alright, alright, I got it."

dialogues.jp:
携帯用の灰皿に、タバコの先を押しつける。薄
い煙が、一筋立ち上った。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei took out a small ashtray and stubbed the
cigarette into it, extinguishing the tiny flame.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei took out a small ashtray and stubbed the
cigarette into it, extinguishing the tiny flame.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ねえ、お姉ちゃん、私、ほんとに心配してる
　んだからね……」
dialogues.en: "You know, sis, I'm really worried about you..."
dialogues.text: "You know, sis, I'm really worried about you..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「う、う〜ん、気持ちはありがたいんだけど、
　こればっかりはどうにもね……」
dialogues.en:
"Y, yeah, I'm sorry for worrying you, but this isn't easy to
stop, and..."
dialogues.text:
"Y, yeah, I'm sorry for worrying you, but this isn't easy to
stop, and..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「それに、ほら、今は……」
dialogues.en: "Besides, right now..."
dialogues.text: "Besides, right now..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの視線が、こちらにちらりと送られる。
と、それがすぐに伏せられてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I caught Kotori sneaking a quick glance at me before turning
back to her sister.
dialogues.text:
I caught Kotori sneaking a quick glance at me before turning
back to her sister.

dialogues.jp:
……どうも、姉妹の間で目配せがあったらしい
が、一体、何だろう？
dialogues.en:
...That seemed like some secret message between them. What
are they thinking now?
dialogues.text:
...That seemed like some secret message between them. What
are they thinking now?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、あたしもなるべく我慢するようにするか
　らさ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I'd try my hardest to keep myself from smoking
another..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I'd try my hardest to keep myself from smoking
another..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "O, okay..."
dialogues.text: "O, okay..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「もう、ほんとに。是非そうしてくれないと、
　タバコにワサビを塗っちゃうからね」
dialogues.en:
"Geez, really, I should just replace all the tobacco in your
cigarettes with wasabi..."
dialogues.text:
"Geez, really, I should just replace all the tobacco in your
cigarettes with wasabi..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「お手柔らかに……んじゃ、メシでも食べに行
　きますか。お姉ちゃんがおごってあげる」
dialogues.en:
"That reminds me... we should go for lunch now. C'mon, the
treat's on me."
dialogues.text:
"That reminds me... we should go for lunch now. C'mon, the
treat's on me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: ガラガラ──。
dialogues.en: --*clatter clatter*
dialogues.text: --*clatter clatter*

dialogues.jp:
と、ドアの所から、ことりが首だけを突き出し
て、言った。
dialogues.en: Kotori's neck peeped back out from outside the door.
dialogues.text: Kotori's neck peeped back out from outside the door.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君。早く行かないと、昼休み終わっちゃ
　うよ」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-kun, if you don't hurry, lunch break's gonna be
over."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-kun, if you don't hurry, lunch break's gonna be
over."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お、おう」
dialogues.en: "O, ohh."
dialogues.text: "O, ohh."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、俺も一緒していいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it really okay for me to be together with you two?"
dialogues.text: "Is it really okay for me to be together with you two?"

dialogues.jp:
何となく、姉妹水入らずといった感じがしたの
だが。
dialogues.en:
I somehow got the feeling that this would be a private
conversation between siblings.
dialogues.text:
I somehow got the feeling that this would be a private
conversation between siblings.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いいよねえ？」
dialogues.en: "It's fine, right?"
dialogues.text: "It's fine, right?"

dialogues.jp:
水を向けられた暦先生は、にやっと、ちょっと
いい女に笑った。
dialogues.en:
Kotori looked towards Koyomi smiling. She looks much better
with a smile.
dialogues.text:
Kotori looked towards Koyomi smiling. She looks much better
with a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ま、ことりがそれでいいって言うなら」
dialogues.en: "Well, if Kotori's fine with it."
dialogues.text: "Well, if Kotori's fine with it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何か、ヤな笑い方」
dialogues.en: "What's with that tiny grin?"
dialogues.text: "What's with that tiny grin?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりと俺とでは、どうやら感じ方に違いがあ
るようだった。
dialogues.en:
I don't think I'd ever have a connection with Kotori like
Koyomi-sensei does.
dialogues.text:
I don't think I'd ever have a connection with Kotori like
Koyomi-sensei does.

dialogues.jp: ◆暦先生とタバコ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Koyomi-sensei and Cigarettes◆
dialogues.text: ◆Koyomi-sensei and Cigarettes◆

dialogues.jp:
声が聞こえたので中に入ると、ことりと暦先
生が居た。何故か、ことりは怒っていたよう
だが……。
dialogues.en:
I followed a voice I heard in the hallways, and found Kotori
and Koyomi-sensei. Kotori was looking a bit angry.
dialogues.text:
I followed a voice I heard in the hallways, and found Kotori
and Koyomi-sensei. Kotori was looking a bit angry.

dialogues.jp:
と、その理由が判明する。どうやらことりは、
暦先生の喫煙に文句を言っていたらしい。
dialogues.en:
As it turns out, Kotori was just displeased at Koyomi-sensei
smoking cigarettes.
dialogues.text:
As it turns out, Kotori was just displeased at Koyomi-sensei
smoking cigarettes.

dialogues.jp:
と、何となく仲直りした様子の二人。ことりは、
俺も一緒に昼食に誘ってくれたのだった。
dialogues.en:
In the end, they appeared to make up. Kotori then invited me
to eat with them afterwards.
dialogues.text:
In the end, they appeared to make up. Kotori then invited me
to eat with them afterwards.
